inspiration: decbench:O0-bash-bash-shell_initialize; widens angr ITERegionConverter (_find_ite_assignment_regions) + iteboolean condition matching over a concatenated BlockList
decisions: New named option rather than an unflagged widening of iteregion/iteboolean: `iteexpr` is the standing precedent for shipping a broadening of the same matcher as its own option (it widens the ARM match; this widens the CONDITION match), and the standing rule is that anything that can change emitted C sits behind a named option. The new flag also buys the two-pass stage test that pins the exact ceil(N/2) defect, which a pre-existing flag cannot (turning `iteregion` off removes ALL ternaries, not the every-other ones).
